question: Should the agent activity timeline surface be built now from existing live/per-session signals, wait for the metadata-only audit ledger foundation, or be narrowed to the current browser-local Activity tab plus trajectory export?
rationale: The source has enough partial observability primitives for several designs, but the public UI/CLI/export contract, persistence owner, retention, authorization, and redaction semantics need maintainer product and security intent.

options.title: Use metadata-audit foundation first
options.body: Make the open metadata-only audit ledger the canonical durable source, then build the timeline surfaces as bounded readers over it.

options.title: Ship an ephemeral timeline only
options.body: Add a non-durable live timeline over `session.tool` and agent events while explicitly deferring JSON export and cross-session history.

options.title: Keep current Activity/trajectory surfaces
options.body: Decline a first-class timeline for now and leave operators with the browser-local Activity tab plus per-session trajectory export.

recommendation.title: Use metadata-audit foundation first
recommendation.body: Make the open metadata-only audit ledger the canonical durable source, then build the timeline surfaces as bounded readers over it.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest overlap across the agent lifecycle history and the open metadata-only audit design issue.
